# Method: interpolation method for percentiles

def percentile(data, p):
    n = len(data)
    k = (n - 1) * p / 100
    f = int(k)
    c = f + 1 if f + 1 < n else f
    return data[f] + (k - f) * (data[c] - data[f])

# Using linear interpolation for percentiles (standard method)
def percentile(data, p):
    n = len(data)
    k = (n - 1) * p / 100
    f = int(k)
    c = f + 1 if f + 1 < n else f
    return data[f] + (k - f) * (data[c] - data[f])
